say:1:1029732001:1.text: I-I'm sorry! I messed up! I'm just a ship mercenary trying to keep my crew fed!
say:1:1029732001:1.source_cn: 对，对不起！我错了！我真的只是一个航船佣兵，带着兄弟们...

say:2:1029732002:1.text: It was all for an urgent job. We were just following orders!
say:2:1029732002:1.source_cn: 去这位兄弟的船上应聘也好，打扮成这样也罢，我们都是接了...

choice_prompt:3:1029732002.text: It was all for an urgent job. We were just following orders!
choice_prompt:3:1029732002.source_cn: 去这位兄弟的船上应聘也好，打扮成这样也罢，我们都是接了某个急单，拿钱办事的啊！

say:4:1029732003:0.text: It was a rush job with a big bounty! We're broke. We jumped at the chance.
say:4:1029732003:0.source_cn: 是，那个单子要得急，所以赏金也特别多，我们好些天没工作了……

say:5:1029732005:1.text: The target was that rich-looking guy we jumped—they said he'd show up in Rustport.
say:5:1029732005:1.source_cn: 那个订单的目标就是我们动手的那个富家小少爷，说是会出现...

say:6:1029732006:1.text: The client was clueless. Wanted us to intercept his ship but didn't even give the ship name! How were we supposed to prep in time?!
say:6:1029732006:1.source_cn: 委托人好像不怎么懂行，还想让我们去拦截他坐的船，但又没...

say:7:1029732007:1.text: And we've got zero naval combat experience, so we figured we'd just hit him here instead.
say:7:1029732007:1.source_cn: 再说了，我们也没有海战的经验，就决定在锈锚港动手了。

say:8:1029732008:0.text: Shaken by the threat of being jailed as Water Wights, the man spills everything.
say:8:1029732008:0.source_cn: 被你们恐吓住的头目生怕真的被当成水鬼帮送进监牢，于是知...

say:9:1029732009:1.text: With Sinbad, you compare Rowan's departure time, the timing of the bounty, and the thugs' movements...
say:9:1029732009:1.source_cn: 你们与辛巴达一起核对了罗万出航的时间，订单下达的时间，...

say:10:1029732010:1.text: Eventually, you piece together a clear timeline.
say:10:1029732010:1.source_cn: 最终理清了一条完整的时间线。

say:14:1029732011:1.text: So it all lines up. Just hours after we left, someone learned where Rowan was headed and sent out the bounty.
say:14:1029732011:1.source_cn: 也就是说，我们出发后几个小时，那个幕后黑手就得知了罗万...

say:15:1029732012:1.text: But they were so inexperienced, they couldn't find the right people—or even make the plan work.
say:15:1029732012:1.source_cn: 只是因为经验不足，既没有找到可靠的合作对象，也没能确保...

say:16:1029732013:1.text: Hmph. The bounty was pretty high... just proves the client's a sucker with money to burn.
say:16:1029732013:1.source_cn: 唔，这个赏金给得倒是不少……更能证明这人像是个冤大头了。

say:17:1029732014:1.text: Around here, whether folks back Sonja or not, most of us are broke. If someone's got a problem, they'd handle it themselves.
say:17:1029732014:1.source_cn: 锈锚港这边，如今不管支不支持索尼娅，大家基本都是穷光蛋...

say:18:1029732015:1.text: Which means it's most likely someone on Rowan's side of things.
say:18:1029732015:1.source_cn: 所以应该能确定，就是那位小少爷自己招来的人。

choice_prompt:19:1029732015.text: Which means it's most likely someone on Rowan's side of things.
choice_prompt:19:1029732015.source_cn: 所以应该能确定，就是那位小少爷自己招来的人。

say:20:1029732016:0.text: Yeah. We can't let someone who's actually doing good work get backstabbed by some sneaky lowlife!
say:20:1029732016:0.source_cn: 嗯，可不能让努力办事的人被这种偷偷摸摸鬼鬼祟祟的家伙暗害了！

say:24:1029732018:1.text: You? You can enjoy a little "vacation" in the Whispers' dungeon. And just so you know, we don't actually arrest every single Water Wight.
say:24:1029732018:1.source_cn: 你就去血薇帮的大牢里度几天假吧——抱歉刚刚骗了你，血薇...

say:25:1029732019:1.text: But daylight assault on a merchant? That comes with consequences!
say:25:1029732019:1.source_cn: 但当街袭击商人，你这种犯罪行径可就少不了惩罚了！

say:27:1029732004:0.text: Yup, urgent and well-paying—and it sounded easy. We couldn't say no.
say:27:1029732004:0.source_cn: 对，不但是个急单，还是个大单，看起来也很轻松，我们一看...
